components.note: Opening thesis and Lakatos framing (n.1), L1-L3, C1-C7, C3' and C6', inference types (a)-(e), lambda-continuum (1)-(6) and (2') with n.2, instance confirmation, von Wright's (7) and (8), constituents (9)-(11), Bayes (12), Jerusalem and combined systems (13)-(14), two-dimensional continuum (15)-(19), generalized combined system (15')-(25), axioms A1-A6, the Kemeny-Carnap theorem, the K-dimensional system with (26), the P(C^K) product, (27), (28) and nn.3-4. All numbered source formulas (1)-(75) occur in the body.

History (Hacking, Laplace, Jevons, Cambridge and subjective schools, Kaila, von Wright, Carnap's 1929 letter and 1942-44 start, LFP and Continuum, Kemeny, Bar-Hillel), the 1965 Helsinki symposium, identity (Hilpinen 1966), order (Tuomela 1966), full first-order logic (Hilpinen 1971) with nn.5-6 (Los; Nix-Paris), the depth-2 analysis, Uchii's modal extension (29)-(31) and Plenitude, semantic information (32)-(37) with n.7, HP/PR/SC/CE and (38)-(43), ravens and grue, acceptance (44)-(45) with n.8, cognitive decision theory (46)-(55) with n.9, theories (IS), (IS') and (56)-(57). Written proof steps exist in the annex for every stated theorem; results the chapter only reports (K-dimensional representation, (21), (24), (27), (28), (31), the n0 threshold, (43), (56)) are marked as reported without proof. Printed slips ((11) with '=', the gamma product typo, the -1 versus -K parameter formula, (54)/(55) for q<1, the (42) hypothesis) are flagged rather than silently modernized.

The source's worked cases and comparisons are present: Hempel's two-law theory T example, the F1/F2 analogy (58)-(60), the distance examples 1/2 and 1, similarity influence, Kuipers (61) with n.10, observational errors (62), truthlikeness (63)-(73) with the gamma'/gamma about 1/2 rule, PAT (74)-(75), ESC with (13'), (72'), (73'), the Earman/Kelly comparison and white-swan case, the SLLN urn case and n.11, and the evaluation (Hacking, Carnap's lambda in [1/2, K] and lambda = 1, Walk n.12, Suppes's structural axioms, the two-Q-predicate parameter-space example C1-C3, Hintikka 1997 and the interrogative model, n.13 reply and objection, closing assessment with n.14). Modern reconstructions state their hypotheses (Kemeny-Carnap: K>=3 or affine f for K=2; PAT part 2 in conditional form; the Tr reduction to Levi needs the q<=1 inequality), claim types are kept separate per def:p15-w02b-p15-030-claim-types, and the proofboundary lists proved versus reported items.

duties.duty: The exact selected induction/confirmation source presentation must be authored; modern probability or a historical mention is not replacement source credit.
duties.note: Niiniluoto's chapter is reconstructed section by section (pp.311-352) with page locators; links to the Carnap chapter supplement but do not replace it.

observations: Held copy is the camera-ready author copy with printed (c)2009 footer and pagination 311-356 matching the 2011 published chapter. The held-sources.json entry has empty source_ids; the packet's held_paths list unrelated files.

Minor elisions only, not judged gaps: Hilpinen's explicit numerical-quantifier wording ('at least d' / 'precisely d-1') and Uchii's remark that the assumption eliminates the K-c nomic constituents are compressed; Niiniluoto's sentence that PAT convergence admits similar ESC modifications is not repeated.
The added worked example def:p15-w02b-p15-030-nn-worked (body 1855-1876) is not from the source; it is not counted as the source's worked case.
The chapter file is not yet input in handbook/parts/p15.tex or handbook/annex/p15.tex; host wiring is a later integration step per the packet insertion spec. Coverage was assessed on the owned files.
Correctness of the mathematics was not assessed; only presence of written steps.
